turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I cleaned the whole house for Joy and I even washed the bedroom window.
Tell me more about that.
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
And how was that for you?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I cooked a chicken roast for Joy, the first proper meal in months.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy. Yes, it was like that.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little.
What happened next?
We decided to give most of Denise's clothes to the hospice charity shop and keep her blue coat.
What happened next?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. I think so, yes.
And how was that for you?
Joy and I sat down together and opened Denise's wardrobe, and we both cried.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment. Yes, it was like that.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
Thank you, see you next week.
